summary: Analyse survey, production and market evidence with FIES, IPC and Excel. Build practical food security reporting skills; explore the five-day course.
lede: Food security data analytics combines household, production and market data to assess food access and changing conditions. For food security analysts, agricultural statisticians and programme teams, the training develops skills to validate survey and administrative data, calculate and interpret indicators such as FIES, FCS and HDDS, compare seasonal trends with price and production signals, and present limitations in an Excel dashboard and decision brief.
audienceIntro: This course suits professionals who analyse agricultural production, household food access or food security programme evidence and need to strengthen how they turn mixed data into defensible findings.
prerequisites: Working familiarity with agricultural, nutrition or food security data is recommended. You should be comfortable working with spreadsheet tables and basic calculations; no programming is required.
topics: Statistics & data analysis (SPSS, Stata, R, Python)
